programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Den framgångsrike journalisten David har alltid försökt ge sin älskade son allt han behöver. Men vare sig David eller Nics mamma Vicki kan hindra sonen från att börja experimentera med crystal meth.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Ett kapat flygplan kommer att krascha om bara 97 minuter när bränslet tar slut. NSA-chefen vill att planet ska skjutas ner innan dess och lämnar de oskyldiga passagerarnas öde i händerna på en hemlig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: A Family Man
programme.desc: Dane Jensen är en hämningslös headhunter på ett företag med mördande konkurrens. När Danes chef låter honom mäta sina krafter med Lynn Vogel börjar Dane ladda för sitt yrkeslivs hårdaste strid.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: När tre banditer tar en framstående läkare i staden som gisslan på jakt efter en försvunnen kvinna kallas sheriff Watts in för att hantera situationen innan FBI anländer.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 629

programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Candid Confessions!
programme.desc: Mistie says that her man has been disloyal, but never guessed her best friend! Jose's two boyfriends don't know that they've been sharing him. Antjuan hates that his girlfriend strips for a living.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Baby, I've Been Bad!
programme.desc: Tonya wants to tell her man that she's pregnant and cheating with her transsexual roommate, Gina! Mike has been sleeping with his fiancé’s cousin for a year! Then, Jimmy has a pregnant fiancé AND girlfriend!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Angry Lovers Explode!
programme.desc: Hope is here to confront her best friend, Laura, for stealing her boyfriend, Joey, and then becoming engaged to him. Next, John will claim he's not to be blamed for sleeping with his girlfriend's best friend!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Three Sisters Share A Man!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: It's Your Fault I'm Cheating!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Line Goes Dead

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Tortured Soul

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lock the Door

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Call for Murder
programme.desc: Five people are shot in a cold-blooded robbery. With much of the evidence lost in a fire set by the suspect. An exhaustive manhunt ends in a chilling confrontation with an Eagle Scout turned killer.

programme.title: Wives With Knives
programme.desc: After a tough childhood, Missey Martinez finds stability in the world of stripping, then she starts dating her high school crush and makes a high-stakes gamble that ends in violence.

programme.title: Wives With Knives
programme.desc: Living the fast life, Trena Archie gets involved with countless powerful men, then, after being exploited one too many times, Archie gets her revenge -- with a knife.

programme.title: Wives With Knives
programme.desc: After surviving a difficult childhood, Laura Lewis becomes involved with a cheater who beats her and fights back with a knife.

programme.title: Little Manhatttan
programme.desc: I världens största nöjesstad är två unga vänner på väg attfå uppleva sitt livs äventyr! Gabe (Josh Hutcherson) ochRosemary (Charlie Ray) har känt varandra nästan helalivet.

programme.title: The Catcher Was a Spy
programme.desc: En ovanlig spion utför ett hemligt uppdrag under andra världskriget, där verklighet och bedrägeri konfronteras i en intensiv kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: En ung kvinna verkar vara den enda överlevaren efter ett kärnvapenkrig, och hon lever på egen hand, helt utan någon omkring sig. Men en dag får hon syn på den största överraskningen i sitt liv: en annan människa.

programme.title: The Keeper
programme.desc: Roland Sallinger (STEVEN SEAGAL) blir uppringd av en desperat Connor Wells, en tidigare kollega från S.W.A.T. –styrkan. Hänsynslösa kriminella har i ett försök att kidnappa Connors dotter Nikita, åsadkommit ett fruktansvärt blodbad.

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: John, en ganska misslyckad äventyrare som fastnat i Reno, har nästan slut på pengar när Sydney bjuder honom på frukost och ger honom tips om hur man tjänar pengar i casinon. Två år senare är John Sydneys partner.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: How to Be
programme.desc: Art (Robert Pattinson) blir dumpad av flickvännen och flyttar tillbaka hem till mamma och pappa och hamnar i en 25-årskris. Art lägger sitt arv på inköp och new age-terapi och tar så småningom även hjälp av en excentrisk själv-hjälps-guru, Dr Ellington.

programme.title: L.A. Gigolo
programme.desc: en unga och charmerande Nicki (Ashton Kutcher) lever ett liv som enbart de snyggaste kan drömma om. Han svindlar till sig en luxuös livsstil genom att tillfredställa rika kvinnor i sängen – och han är djävulskt bra på det!

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Oscar®-vinnaren Morgan Freeman spelar här en filmstjärna som ger sig ut på rollförberedande research i ett snabbköp i Los Angeles. Han möter en snabbtalande kassörska och de ger sig av på en gemensam resa för att visa varandra sina respektive världar.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night One
programme.desc: Livet förändras för alltid för fem barndomskompisar från Roxbury i Massachusetts när de bildar en sånggrupp för att vinna lokala talangjakter och i slutänden blir den legendariska R&B-gruppen New Edition.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Reading The Signs
programme.desc: Mary Janes utläggning sprids på nätet och hon blir känd över en natt. Sheldon vill fördjupa förhållandet med Mary Jane och Kara åker hem för att hjälpa till att lösa ett familjeproblem.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Signing Off
programme.desc: Mary Jane Paul tycks ha allt: intelligens, framåtanda, ett vackert hem, sportbil och en lyxig garderob med designerskor. Ändå saknas nåt i hennes amerikanska dröm - en egen familj.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Facing Fears
programme.desc: När Mary Jane åker in på sjukhus efter sin olycka samlas familjen runt henne. Paul Sr tar hand om David och Helen avlastar dem och tar hand om Lisa medan Kara kämpar för Mary Jane på SNC.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Two
programme.desc: Trots att New Edition blir R&B-sensationer får de betala ett högt pris för sin framgång när interna stridigheter och yttre tryck leder till att de sätter affärerna framför vänskapen.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Louie Louie
programme.desc: När Mary Jane är fast i hemma och inte kan göra nåt så hopar sig problemen då Cece avslöjar sina utpressningsplaner. Samtidigt anställer SNC Marisol, en ny snygg latina-ersättare.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Svenska Emelie har haft några tuffa år. Hennes år av alkohol- och spelberoende har inte bara kostat henne dyrt i privatlivet. Hon är också skyldig pengar till höger och vänster.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2508
programme.desc: I Munkebo drömmer 24-åriga Maria och 34-årige Anders om att köpa ett hus och en bebis, men drömmen är helt orealistisk - för i Anders förflutna med både droger och brott har han byggt upp en stor skuld.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: När Emma och Mike träffades på semester var det kärlek vid första anblick. De flyttade snabbt ihop - men Mike lånar pengar från allt och alla och använder dem för att spela.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Niels drömmer om ett liv med Malene. Men för att det ska bli verklighet måste Niels reda ut sin kaotiska ekonomi, som inkluderar snabblån, obetalda räkningar och skulder.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2909
programme.desc: Daniella är en ensamstående mamma som drömmer om att ha råd att ta med sitt barn till en nöjespark. Men det visar sig snart att hon lätt kan göra det, bara hon minskar sitt bruk av energidrycker.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Bronson
programme.desc: Charles Bronson, född Michael Peterson, är Englands mest våldsbenägne intern. Redan som barn drömde han om att bli berömd, men visste inte för vad tills den dagen han rånade ett postkontor.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: Den otroliga men sanna historien om tre polska bröder som under andra världskriget gjorde motstånd mot den massiva tyska ockupationsmakten, något som räddade tusentals människor.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den före detta CIA-agenten Robert lever i ett hemligt sällskap för pensionerade spioner. Nu är hans son Paul i knipa och behöver hans hjälp - men Pauls planer är inte alls lika hemliga som hans fars liv.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Det är en ny vecka och alla är spända på att se vem som blir veckans restaurangchef. Det går inte att förneka deras beslutsamhet, men hur länge kommer den att hålla?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 706
programme.desc: Restaurangchefen får en abrupt start på dagen som sätter hela teamet på en ostadig kurs mot menyprovningen. Det blir dålig stämning när flera deltagare låtsas att deras maträtt har kvalitetskontrollerats.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 707
programme.desc: Kommunikationen bryter samman fullständigt när restaurangchefen går in i "diktatorläge". Kjartan och gästen glöms helt bort, och varför i hela friden klappar gästerna händerna och skriker "BABEK"?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 708
programme.desc: Det är tävlingsdag och en ny deltagare skickas hem. Lärlingskampen avgörs med minsta möjliga marginal när smaklökar och kräkreflexer utmanas hos flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 709
programme.desc: Många vill bli restaurangchefer, men deras entusiasm övergår snabbt i frustration när det står klart att gruppen delas upp i två lag. Två nya deltagare anländer, men kommer det att bli mer förbannelse än glädje för lagen?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 710
programme.desc: Ett av lagen blir frustrerat när en deltagare sover bort morgonen istället för att hjälpa till. Båda lagen gör stora misstag, och de två restaurangcheferna är rädda för att behöva göra årets mellanmål.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: Idag möter vi Dorthe, som har så svårt att släppa taget om sitt gamla jag att hon har kvar sina infekterade implantat. Michela skäms över sina bröst och gömmer sig i stora luvtröjor.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: Vi möter Melissa som ångrar sin operation djupt, och Helle, som täcker sig efter sin operation på armarna. Samtidigt är Lenes högsta önskan att kunna göra något bra för sig själv.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 902
programme.desc: Efter en bröstoperation har Samantha tunga, smärtsamma bröst och ett förhållande som är i gungning. Allan har senare uttryckt sin oenighet med Samanthas förklaring till varför förhållandet tog slut.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Misslyckad plastikkirurgi har lämnat tre patienter med ärr på både kropp och själ. Nu är två av landets skickligaste plastikkirurger redo att erbjuda sin hjälp igen.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Misslyckade plastikoperationer ger kvinnor ärr på både kropp och själ. Vi möter Sasja som har gjort en bröstförminskning, men nu känner att hon måste dölja sina bröst som är olika stora.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Vi möter Jonna, som efter sin plastikoperation tycker att hennes mage ser ut som en bombkrater. Hon kämpar samtidigt med en otäck lukt från sin navel.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Deja Vu All Over Again
programme.desc: Alla är frustrerade över Mikes beteende. Han får alla utkastade från en klubb, får bilen bortbogserad, bränner nästan ner huset och misslyckas som Paulys ragghjälp. Två gånger!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Back into the Fold
programme.desc: Pauly och Vin går på en sista dejt med sina Miamitjejer medan Sam och Rons sista måltid utvecklas till ett gräl. Jenni ser till att det blir ordentligt med dramatik i bubbelpoolen med Pauly och Mike.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Back to the Shore
programme.desc: Vännerna är tillbaka för ännu en galen sommar på Jersey Shore! Eftersom Angelina försvunnit har Snooki tagit med sig sin vän Deena. Spänningen mellan tjejerna från Miami exploderar och snart flyger knytnävar och löshår i luften.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: It's Gonna Be an Interesting Summer
programme.desc: Bråket mellan Sammi och JWoww orsakar spänning i huset. Ronnie och Sammi fortsätter att isolera sig och missar första familjemiddagen. När Ronnie bestämmer sig för att umgås och ha kul med resten av huset känner sig Sammi ensam.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Where's the Beach
programme.desc: Sammi bestämmer sig för att sluta fred med Snooki och Deena. JWoww stöter på sin gamla kärlek Roger och det slår gnistor. Snooki anhålls för fylla på allmän plats.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Free Snooki
programme.desc: Efter att Snooki anhållits är hon deprimerad tills hon träffar en ny kille. Deena träffar Ronnies stuntman. Samtidigt gör JWoww och Tom slut.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The Pressure Is On As The Girls Compete For A Spot As One Of The Final Two Models; Ivan Bart Of Img Models Is Guest Judge.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: And The Winner Is?

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Kelly Osbourne
programme.desc: The first photo shoot has the women squaring off while posing as famous British and American public figures.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Kris Jenner
programme.desc: Some of the models resist getting make-overs and a few of them are unhappy with their new looks.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Cat Deeley
programme.desc: The women must create an ad campaign, which includes casting, wardrobe, providing props and hair and make-up.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: J. Alexander
programme.desc: The American women start to break down while the British rally together. Kelly Cutrone and Nigel Barker join J. Alexander and Tyra Banks on the judges' panel for elimination.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Preliminary Auditions
programme.desc: I denna två timmar långa säsongpremiär av Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team kommer 600 hoppfulla kandidater till Cowboys Stadium för Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders preliminära uttagningar.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Training Camp
programme.desc: Träningslägret börjar och många av de nya kandidaterna har behövt bryta upp och flytta till Dallas utan garanti för att de klarar lägret och blir en Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader .

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Jump Split
programme.desc: Det är bara andra repetitionsveckan och Kelli och Judy är snabba med att gå igenom DCC-rörelserna med kandidaterna. Många av de nya kandidaterna har aldrig gjort ett spagathopp och deras brist på erfarenhet gör att några av flickorna skadar sig.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeover
programme.desc: Det är fjärde träningsveckan och utmanarna får en DCC-makeover. Under Kelli Finglass överinseende får tjejerna DCC-looken med nya frisyrer och och ny sminkning.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Week Five
programme.desc: Det är femte träningsveckan och Kelli är borta på grund av sjukdom. DCC:s tekniska ledare, Kitty Carter, hoppar in och leder veckans första repetition. Kitty är brutalt ärlig när hon påpekar att flera av tjejerna dansar slarvigt.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 13
programme.desc: The staff at Barnsley casualty are enjoying an unusually peaceful start to the day and superstition dictates that on days like this, there’s one word that must never be uttered - the Q word!

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 14
programme.desc: There’s a new Matron in charge at Barnsley Casualty today - it’s Hannah’s first day in her new role but it’s not going to be an easy one. The department is completely full, there’s no movement and patients just keep on arriving.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 15
programme.desc: The first heatwave of summer has hit Barnsley and it’s adding to the pressure of an already stressful day in casualty for Sister Jane who’s in charge today. The department is hot, stuffy, and bursting with patients all needing emergency treatment.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 16
programme.desc: It’s another relentless shift for the team at Barnsley casualty and running the hub today is Sister Jane. Staff are struggling to meet the 15-minute assessment target time but doing all they can.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 17
programme.desc: It’s a big day at Barnsley Casualty, for the first time since the Covid pandemic hit the UK, staff can finally remove their masks. For some it’s a happy, welcome relief, but others aren’t ready to go mask-free just yet.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 18
programme.desc: It’s the hottest day of the year at Barnsley Casualty. Sister Vicky has the job of keeping patients and staff cool, but with temperatures outside approaching forty degrees, it won’t be easy.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 1
programme.desc: Hoarding is on the rise and it's believed that 1 in 20 people could have a problem. With over 1.2 million problem hoarders in the UK today, one could be your neighbour?

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 2
programme.desc: Susan's hoard has made her virtually homeless. Brian has dedicated his life to hoarding and his daughter is sick of it. Jake is lucky to be alive as his home almost burned to the ground in an inferno fuelled by the clutter he'd collected.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 3
programme.desc: Arthur's flat is packed with junk. Experts Caz and Tee are up for their toughest assignment ever. Khim is getting married but first she must clear her hoard. Mandi's passion for vintage clothes is out of control.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 4
programme.desc: Esther's hoard is so bad her landlord told her to clear up or clear out. Nigel receives a visit from fellow hoarder Janice.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 12
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Alan, a sound therapist who has lived on his own for 20 years. His son has tried to help him clean, but it’s a battle he’s never been able to win.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 10
programme.desc: Crouch recovery op Buzz is forced to abandon his wrecker as he attempts to rescue a stranded skip lorry. Merrie is faced with a 26-tonne water tanker stuck on a narrow lane and on the A4 a fully loaded truck has rolled over on a busy roundabout.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 11
programme.desc: A 44-tonne lorry in a catastrophic crash on the M25 calls for a multi-crew rescue, company patriarch Dave Crouch shows apprentice Olly the ropes and Merrie tackles a water tanker stuck on a dangerous blind bend.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 12

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Tortured Soul

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Avert Your Eyes

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Powder Kegs
